title: Gap Fill Toward an FVG
summary: The gap-fill rate when an unfilled session-level fair value gap sat on a chosen side of the open at session start. With the defaults — gapped up, FVG below — the prior close and the zone lie on the same side of the open, so filling the gap is movement toward the zone: the magnet reading. The denominator is sessions that gapped the chosen way AND carried such a zone (zones form on prior sessions only, no lookahead); the numerator is the ones that traded back to the prior close. The zone's whole contribution is the difference against the plain same-direction gap-fill rate — flip the parameters to test the opposing case.

params.name: side
params.doc: Side of the open the unfilled FVG must sit on (below pairs with up-gaps, above with down-gaps, for the aligned magnet reading).

deltas: a compositional question — gap state x FVG state — that fixed single-topic reports cannot ask
aligned and opposing configurations are the same preset with flipped parameters
time-to-fill distribution shows whether the zone changed the clock, not just the rate
